title: epipactis purpurata var. pollinensis
intro: Epipactis purpurata var. pollinensis, commonly known as the Purple Helleborine, is a type of orchid plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. The Purple Helleborine is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve immune function, owing to its health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory agent, antiviral, and immunomodulator, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as herpes and cancer. The bioactive constituents of Epipactis purpurata var. pollinensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
